name: ssh-server
description: 本机网页：与本机 Claude Code / Codex 对话并操作 SSH 服务器上的项目

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run dup && npm run coverage
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ssh-server/server" "npm run dev -w @ssh-server/web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @ssh-server/web && npm run start -w @ssh-server/server
